thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT OPENED - P1: inference-serving-prod high 5xx rate (5m avg) -> paging oncall

oncall-bot: Alert details: metric=inference.http_error_rate, env=prod, value=12.7%, threshold=5% for 5m. Links: https://grafana.redwood/inference/alert/12345

Maya R.: I'm oncall. Paging Leo to help triage, pinging Zheng and Anya for visibility.

Leo P.: looking. first glance: spike started ~12:03 UTC, multiple hosts reporting 502/503 from model-host pool.

Zheng: confirmed. k8s logs show repeated upstream reset on model-host-3. snippet:
```
[2026-02-18T12:03:14Z] proxy error: upstream reset by peer, host=model-host-3.dedicated.svc.cluster.local:8080
[2026-02-18T12:03:14Z] 502 GET /v1/streams -> 502
```

Anya: any deploys around that time?

deploy-bot: deploy event: service=inference-serving, commit=ad7f9e2, env=prod, started=2026-02-18T12:01:10Z, finished=2026-02-18T12:02:04Z (success)

Maya R.: hmm deploy finished right before spike. Leo/ Zheng: can you roll back or restart the handful of model-host-3 replicas?

Leo P.: doing a rolling restart for model-host-3 replicas now. Observability: I'll tail errors and health checks.

ops-bot: note: routing: 8% of traffic was routed to model-host-3 over last 10m (weighting by LB)

Zheng: restart triggered. health-checks took a bit, one pod stuck in crashloop -> kube evicted & rescheduled.

Anya: I'm watching error rate drop. 12:10 UTC = 3.1% and trending down.

Maya R.: nice. marking incident as mitigated. Can we verify customer impact? Any support tickets?

Leo P.: Customer impact: short tails of 502s for ~6 minutes, some API retries visible in logs. SRE-runbook: partial degradation, no major data loss. No open support tickets yet; CS will be notified if anything pops.

Maya R.: thanks. Quick retro notes: two problems here - a deploy correlated with host-level upstream resets + alert flapping (saw repeated P1s in last 2 weeks for similar signal). We should tune the alerting and build a small retrospective dashboard to avoid hunting in future.

Zheng: agree. Current alert fires on raw error rate > 5% for 5m. That threshold is noisy during rolling deploys. Proposal: change to 1) error_rate > 10% for 3m OR 5% for 10m, and 2) add grouping by node/pod so we page only when a large fraction of hosts are affected.

Anya: also add a suppression rule that suppresses the P1 when a deploy is in-flight for that service (deploy-bot link). We have that capability in alertmanager.

Maya R.: yep. And we need a dedicated Grafana panel set for retrospectives for inference incidents. Minimal panel list I want: golden signals + drilldowns. I'll sketch panels here: 
- Total request rate (qps) by route + model variant
- Error rate (5xx) overall and by host/pod (stacked)
- Latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) by model variant and by input-length bucket
- Inflight requests / concurrency per host
- GPU utilization + memory for model hosts (per-host grid)
- KV cache hit rate and prefix cache miss rate (for prefix-caching issues)
- Recent deploy markers and commit IDs overlayed
- Trace links / sample trace ids for 5xxs

Zheng: for queries we can use these example snippets:
```
# error rate by pod
sum(rate(inference_http_requests_total{code=~"5..",env="prod"}[5m])) by (pod) / sum(rate(inference_http_requests_total{env="prod"}[5m])) by (pod)

# p95 latency by model
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket{env="prod"}[5m])) by (le, model))
```

Leo P.: nice. For drilldowns, let's have top-left panel be an alert overview with clickable links to a per-host error heatmap and to traces. Also include a small box that lists recent deploy commit ids (last 6) so we can eyeball correlation quickly.

Anya: on alert tuning: I'll open an alertmanager PR to update the thresholds and add the deploy suppression rule. Will target prod change window tomorrow if folks agree.

Maya R.: I'll own the Grafana dashboard work. Outline: create folder "incidents/inference" -> panel group "golden signals" -> panels as above. Add templating variable for model, route, and time window. Also add row with quick runbook links and ops-checklist (restart, scale, rollback).

Zheng: I'll make a quick runtime dashboard that surfaces per-host kernel OOMs and tcp resets; might help catch infra-level issues next time.

Leo P.: docs: I'll draft a short postmortem note in #postmortems and link to the new dashboard + alert PR.

Maya R.: action items:
- Maya: create Grafana dashboard + folder + basic panels -> PR, due EOD tomorrow :calendar: (ACTION-1)
- Anya: alertmanager PR for thresholds + deploy suppression -> due tomorrow before prod change window (ACTION-2)
- Zheng: infra-level dashboard and kernel/tcp panel -> due in 3 days (ACTION-3)
- Leo: postmortem draft and customer impact summary -> due in 48h (ACTION-4)

Anya: +1 to assignments. I'll also add a smaller alert that pages to a secondary channel (eng-oncall) at lower severity to reduce P1 churn.

Maya R.: assigning tickets now. I'll link them here when created. Thanks all, closing this thread as incident mitigated but keeping the follow-ups open as tasks. :white_check_mark: 

ops-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-142 created and linked to this thread.

Maya R.: (post-note) when building the dashboard, include a small text panel with quick grep examples for logs and a note about how to find sample trace ids. Saves time during live incidents.

Leo P.: ack. Great work team.
